name: pilot-deployment-trigger-policy
purpose: Prevent routine development packages and pull requests from consuming deployment-provider capacity before release promotion.

rules.pilot_controls_promotion: Pilot release state governs whether deployment is requested.
rules.no_implicit_preview: Creating a routine development PR must not implicitly require a deployment-provider preview.
rules.provider_neutral: The core policy is provider-neutral; provider-specific skip mechanics belong in the deployment adapter.
rules.safety: A skipped deployment may not be represented as production verified.
rules.override: Any explicit deployment override must be intentional, auditable, and scoped to a release candidate.
